newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience up after cancer trial results.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience up after cancer trial results.

text.p: Shares in Chiroscience Plc rose on Monday after the group revealed trial results of two anti-cancer compounds, saying they did not cause side-effects seen in products such as British Biotech Plc's Marimastat.
The stock was up 18-1/2p at 431 while British Biotech was down 2p at 257-1/2.
Chiroscience said it would shortly start clinical trials of the two new compounds, which had shown "excellent selectivity and efficacy " in pre-clinical models.

Robin Gilbert, analyst at Panmure Gordon, said investors would be seeking more information on the cancer drugs given the previous interest in Marimastat and the huge difference in the market capitalisation of Chiroscience and British Biotech.
"Clearly there will be a great deal of interest in what the company has to say," Gilbert said.
Chiroscience holds a briefing for analysts later this morning.
